events.title: What to Expect from Emberville Early Access on October 27th
events.summary: After years of development, we're incredibly excited to finally welcome everyone into Emberville.Before launch, we wanted to share what players can expect on day one, what we're working on next, and how Early Access will help shape the future of the game.Playing the Steam Next Fest Demo?
